How to play Scene Swap

Improv scene that anyone can hijack Two players act out a scene. Anyone can shout 'freeze!' at any moment — then tap one actor and replace them, starting a completely different scene from the frozen position.

3–10 players~10 minHigh Energy & CreativeActing & performance games

How to play

  1. Two players start an improvised scene — any scenario.
  2. At any moment, someone watching can shout 'freeze!' — everyone freezes.
  3. The caller tags one actor and physically takes their position.
  4. From that exact frozen pose, start an entirely new and unrelated scene.
  5. Keep calling freeze and swapping in. The weirder the transition, the better.

Example round

  • Freeze! [person is pointing dramatically] → new scene: 'I told you the butler did it!'
  • Freeze! [person is crouched down] → new scene: a doctor examining a very confused patient
  • The posture gives the new scene its starting energy — that's the magic.

Tips

  • Call freeze when poses are weird or ambiguous — you get more creative options.
  • Don't overthink the new scene — just react to the physical position you're in.
